title: Same-executor free Transformer typed-edge coalition external validity
question: After eliminating the fused-versus-explicit executor mismatch, does the frozen typed-edge camera identify an identity-specific, bidirectionally causal sparse sufficient coalition across depth?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Frozen sparse QK/OV/MLP coalition rescue, wrong-identity response, matched-null response and reverse blocking on unseen worlds.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: At least four of six models, with every depth represented, pass the complete confirmation conjunction.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: The full conjunction fails breadth or any depth has no passing replicate.

hypothesis_predictions.observable: The same confirmation intervention battery after discovery and selection are frozen.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: Free training yields model-specific or nonselective coalitions that rescue behavior without identity, null or reverse-block specificity.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: The registered complete conjunction repeats in breadth.

tasks: source code lookup plus later cyclic mapping

data_contract.cluster_unit: One base, target, wrong-identity and matched-null code-world quartet.

calibration.development: One excluded 3-layer, width-64 seed verifies numerical execution and protocol feasibility.

data_contract.split_rule: Discovery ranks components; selection chooses only among frozen prefix sizes; confirmation cannot select anything.
data_contract.answer_payload_rule: All four natural sequences must independently achieve the task answer before internal interventions are interpreted.

controls: same explicit executor for training, natural evaluation and intervention evaluation

metrics.estimator: Independent task accuracy and native-explicit logit gap.
Correct rescue cosine, relative error, signed projection and target-answer accuracy.
Correct-minus-wrong cosine margin and wrong cosine ceiling.
Matched-null response norm divided by target response norm.
Target response remaining after restoring coalition values from base.

typed_gates.rule: All six models pass all natural conditions and explicit execution equivalence.
Passing models meet correct rescue cosine, error, projection and answer-accuracy thresholds.
Wrong identity and matched-null controls pass together.
Reverse blocking leaves at most 0.40 of the target response.
At least four of six models pass the full conjunction and every depth has at least one pass.
authorizes: one separately frozen Qwen3 single-model contract

budget.right_censoring_rule: No seed replacement, threshold change, role deletion, prefix extension, task change or confirmation reselection.

stopping_rules: This is the terminal local executor-validity rerun; no third interface is allowed.
Any behavior-unqualified seed stays in the denominator.
Leave-one-out is a redundancy diagnostic, not a pass gate.
A pass establishes a sparse sufficient coalition candidate, not a unique minimal algorithm.

adjudication.failure_claim: The registered sparse typed-edge coalition did not satisfy the full rescue, identity, null, reverse-block and breadth conjunction.
adjudication.reopen_condition: Only a genuinely new causal object or external model target can reopen the question; executor variants, failed seeds and thresholds remain frozen.

authorizes_on_pass: one fresh Qwen3 single-model typed-edge external-validity contract
authorizes_on_failure: retain per-model coalitions as descriptive diagnostics
